paper.title: Deterministic MDPs with Adversarial Rewards and Bandit Feedback

settings.name_in_paper: Adversarial-reward deterministic MDP (DMDP) with bandit feedback
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Markov decision process (agent has a state with deterministic transitions); MDP settings are out of scope.
unmapped: agent has a state among n finite states with deterministic known transition function f: S x A -> S
learner knows the transition dynamics and its current state
rewards r_t: S x A -> [0,1] chosen adversarially in advance
DMDP is weakly communicating (communicating after transient states) and satisfies Assumption 1 (any two states in closed set connected by an action sequence of length exactly d)
comparator: best deterministic policy in Pi_{<=L} (cycle length at most L, user-defined L)
settings.definition_quote: An adversarial-reward deterministic Markov decision process (DMDP) is a tuple (S, A, f, r1:T ) where S is a finite set of states, A is a finite set of actions, f : S × A → S is a deterministic state transition function, which maps a state-action pair to the next state, and r1:T is a sequence (rt )Tt=1 of reward functions rt : S × A → [0, 1].

algorithms.name: Algorithm 1 (Fixed length k and state s̄; reduction to BLO)

symbols.L_cyc: maximum cycle length of comparator policies (user-defined L)
symbols.d_path: length d of connecting action sequences in Assumption 1

conditions: comparator restricted to deterministic policies in Pi_{k,s̄} (cycle length k starting and returning to s̄)
tuning: BLO algorithm of Abernethy et al. (2008) with double randomization

source.quote: Assume that we run Algorithm 1 for T rounds with this sequence, with parameters k ≤ L and s̄ ∈ S ... let π* be any deterministic policy in Πk,s̄ ... Then the regret is upper bounded by ... ≤ 4L^2 (n|A|)^{3/2} \sqrt{T log(T)} + (2L + d).

results.notes: Warm-up result for fixed cycle length and start state; comparator is a restricted policy class.

symbols.L_cyc: maximum cycle length of comparator policies (user-defined L)

conditions: comparator: any deterministic policy in Pi_{<=L}
DMDP weakly communicating and Assumption 1 holds
tuning: EXP3 over nL (k,s) pairs, BLO of Abernethy et al. inside each episode

source.quote: Assume that we run MarcoPolo with this sequence for T rounds and with an episode length of τ = √T ... let π* be any deterministic policy in Π≤L ... Then the regret is upper bounded by ... ≤ C T^{3/4} \sqrt{log(T)} + o(T^{3/4}) . where C = 4L^2 (n|A|)^{3/2} + \sqrt{7nL log(nL)}.

results.notes: Exact statement has an additional o(T^{3/4}) term, so recorded with O notation. The placement of the sqrt in C is reconstructed from lossy PDF text (proof gives T^{3/4} sqrt(7nL log(nL))).
